name: the-depth-chart
description: Static site + Vercel functions. package.json exists only so the dynamic OG-image endpoint (api/og-transfer-image.mjs) can use @vercel/og (and api/arb-scan.js can send Web Push alerts with web-push). No build step and NO "type":"module" — the plain CommonJS Node functions in /api keep working; the OG-image function is .mjs (ESM) and builds its image tree as plain objects (no JSX).
